rules.statement: A decree declaring parties entitled to land is a registrable instrument if it purports or operates to create, confer, declare, limit, assign, transfer, charge, incumber, release, or extinguish any right, title or interest in or over land.
rules.supporting_quote: The resulting position is that, today, decrees and orders of any court or authority are registrable instruments if they purport or operate to create, confer, &c., any right, title or interest. . . . . . . . to, in, or over land.
